items.html: *And we shall now explain how, at the time of the death of these kings, their vessels descended to the world of Beria, as mentioned above, unlike the four posteriors of AVI. For it was explained the difference that existed between AVI and the seven kings, which are ZON, and we said that the seven kings, which are ZON, actually died and their vessels descended to the world of Beria, whereas the posteriors of AVI were nullified and did not die, but only descended below within the world of Atzilut itself. And there we explained the reason for this, and we said that it was because the seven kings did not receive the lights of AHP of AK except from its Guf onward.
